lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct vertical line structures; spacing is approximately equidistant in the anterior region, increasing in irregularity toward the posterior.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Significant fragmentation observed in the posterior third of the torso, where lines 9, 10, and 11 exist as a series of vertically aligned dashes rather than continuous strokes.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: High-contrast spot grouping of approximately 8 units located on the lower haunch, inferior to the primary vertical line array.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: A horizontal alignment of three spots is visible on the upper hind limb.

other_distinctive_markers: White transverse band on the lower neck and white spots on the forelimb carpal joints.
